text:
maria: Quick report from docs QA: streaming + model-redirect can ignore client stop sequences when v1 requests are routed to v2 aliases. Minimal repro below.

ivan: paste repro?

maria: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/responses -d '{"model":"legacy/3r","input":"hi","stop":["STOP"]}' -i` follow 307 to `/v2/responses?model=rwd/3r-v2` and stream shows content past STOP.

sdk-jo: we'll add a tiny compatibility helper in both SDKs to preserve stop metadata across redirects and include snippet in migration guide.

infra-lee: proxy currently rewrites model but drops stream metadata header. I'll add copying of stop header and a unit test. Planning Friday low-traffic deploy.

legal-ash: need 30 days notice before behavioral deprecation. If we change behavior, show banner with date.

maria: docs plan: (1) update migration guide with a "Streaming when routed to v2" section, (2) add FAQ entry, (3) update examples to prefer `rwd/*-v2`. Also include emergency workaround: `x-rwd-force-stop: true` header.

sdk-jo: snippet for TS/Py will use `client.responses.stream({model: 'rwd/3r-v2', ...})`. We'll also ship patch release with helper.

deploy-bot: Docs site deploy scheduled tomorrow 03:00 UTC.

maria: I'll open PR and paste link here when ready. Thanks all.
